title: Total energy conversion
description: Essential: Correctly calculates total energy converted from other forms to electrical energy using W = E * q, obtaining 18 J.

title: External circuit energy
description: Essential: Correctly calculates electrical energy converted in external circuit using W1 = U1 * q, obtaining 14.4 J.

title: Internal circuit energy
description: Essential: Correctly calculates electrical energy converted in internal circuit, either via W2 = (E - U1) * q or W2 = W - W1, obtaining 3.6 J.

title: Voltage relationship application
description: Important: Applies the relationship between EMF, terminal voltage, and internal voltage drop (E = U1 + U2) to find internal voltage.

title: Energy conservation check
description: Important: Recognizes that total converted energy equals sum of external and internal conversions (W = W1 + W2) as consistency check.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows proper unit analysis with volts, coulombs, and joules throughout calculations.

title: Confusing EMF with terminal voltage
description: Pitfall: Uses terminal voltage (2.4 V) instead of EMF (3.0 V) when calculating total energy conversion.

title: Sign error in voltage difference
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates internal voltage as U1 - E instead of E - U1.
